name: Nested Clip-Boxes
definition: A novel terrain-rendering method based on nested Clip-Boxes to visualize massive procedural volumetric terrains. It defines the terrain as a 3D function, samples it in a user-defined quadratic view-region around the viewpoint, stores the result as voxel volume data, and converts this volume data into a triangle mesh for hardware-accelerated visualization. It provides high quality rendering and high computational performance by employing level of detail (LOD).
